description:
Client is looking for a Java/API developer for a project with a client in the Pay-TV industry. This is a very strategic project for Client, as they are working on a new logo for their customer. They will be working in a big data environment and will be doing back-end Java development. Having Hadoop and Amazon technologies (Cloud, Redshift, AWS) experience would be extremely helpful since the customer utilizes them. 

 Must Have:
 - 5+ years of Java development experience
 - Strong API development experience
 - Experience customer-facing 
 - Good communication skills are imperative 
 Plusses: (he said this would be the perfect person)
 - Hadoop experience 
 - Previous Amazon experience (TiVo runs Amazon Cloud)
